dedupe_keys.name: mike integrated urban water river and flood modelling platform dhi

description: MIKE+ is DHI's integrated modelling platform for urban water systems, rivers and floodplains, with products for water distribution, collection systems, rivers, 2D overland flow and model management. MIKE+ Water Distribution models and analyses water distribution networks with EPANET simulation, water hammer identification and multi-species water quality, and adds tools that estimate average demand and leakage per zone from measured series and distribute demands to nodes or pipes; the page also names irrigation scheduling and delivery. Coverage is any urban water network, river or flood plain. Access is a paid licence or subscription, with academic licences, and every licence now supports Linux machines as well. Caveats: proprietary software; the pricing page was not read. Simulation uses: network flow, demand and leakage analysis, capacity planning and flood modelling of drainage and sewer systems. Related records: EPANET (model-epanet), OpenFlows Water (model-bentley-openflows-water-watergems) and PCSWMM (platform-pcswmm).
